dict.string: Everboard brings the right terminal tab to the front when you open an agent session, and types the replies you send to sessions running in Terminal or iTerm2.
Everboard shows your upcoming meetings, join links and meeting prep, and keeps notifications quiet while you're in a meeting.
Everboard shows your upcoming meetings and keeps notifications quiet during them.
Everboard listens only after you press the mic button or ⌥⇧Space, so you can talk to your agents.
Everboard turns what you say to the Assistant into text with Apple's speech recognition, on this Mac when it can.
